property_summary: For any given input value _val, after calling SetMinSum(_val) when the contract is not yet initialized, the resulting MinSum must exactly equal _val; the buggy version breaks this because the first assignment MinSum = _val - 1 is not undone by the second assignment when arithmetic underflow occurs, resulting in a value different from _val.
change_summary: Insert MinSum = _val - 1 before the existing assignment so the final stored value differs.
